verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs say users can send manual and automatic invoices with flexible payment methods from their account. They also describe an Accounts Receivable API covering invoice create/update/cancel, PDF download, card or ACH debit collection, and paid-status tracking, with plan-based invoice limits. No evidence addresses invoice branding or customization, and there is no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: evidence of branded/customizable invoice templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
